snippet.title: I Checkmate Thee teaser
snippet.description:
My team and I are in the process of developing a game. “I Checkmate Thee” is a turn-based game with a limited view, in the setting and genre of horror and chess. You play as a sword-wielding chess king who needs to escape the confinement of the chessboard. The king has to go through several chess games, where every move is a step towards death!

Check out our Steam page, we'd love your support) https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703300/I_Checkmate_Thee/
